product.olivetti-m480-60.summary: The Micro Channel M480 with ECC memory and 256 KB secondary cache.
product.olivetti-m480-60.history: The Olivetti service guide documents M480-60 (the Micro Channel M480 with ECC memory and 256 KB secondary cache).
product.olivetti-m480-60.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA307 · UC118 · GO2002 · SCSI. IML boot needs a second part of the code on the first hard disk.
product.olivetti-m480-60.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records EPROM + IML.
product.olivetti-m480-60.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m480-60.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m480-60.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 31-1.
